purpose: Research feeder case generation; scenario names are research templates, not certification of regional/voltage applicability
operating_model: Single source, single voltage; balanced or per-phase unbalanced at 6/10/20kV; energized lines form a tree, with normally open ties stored separately as physical branches

families.name: Spatial-proximity radial
families.use: Compact/elongated spatial layouts and comparison of distance-constrained connections

families.name: Trunk with village clusters
families.use: Clustered loads, a trunk, and local branches; the 80/20 load allocation is an assumption

families.name: Reference-marginal tree
families.use: Comparison against specified EPRI reference marginal statistics; not a complete fit to real morphology

families.name: Long chain
families.use: Supply along a corridor, deeper paths, and voltage-drop studies

families.name: Trunk with multiple laterals
families.use: Several radial laterals branch along the trunk; distinct from village clustering

families.name: Multiple arms from one source
families.use: Multiple radial paths from the same equivalent source; not multiple independent sources

families.name: Hierarchical branching tree
families.use: Depth/branch-count comparisons with regular layers; no claim of engineering optimality

families.name: Irregular branching tree
families.use: Random growth constrained by the maximum child-branch count; morphological diversity across seeds

families.name: Normally open ring
families.use: Physical ring with one normally open break and a radial operating topology; excludes supply restoration and closed-loop dispatch

load_shapes.uniform: Equal active power at all positive-load connection points
load_shapes.downstream_heavy: Increase relative weights toward terminals according to graph depth
load_shapes.upstream_heavy: Increase relative weights toward the source according to graph depth

composition_rules: Non-default load shapes apply only to all_nodes placement in spatial_mst/legacy_random/structured_radial; village/empirical/conditioned placement has its own allocation contracts
structured_radial requires topology; parameters apply only to the listed topology families, and incompatible parameters are rejected
open_ring requires tie_count=1; other layouts may request 0-10 normally open ties. Reject insufficient spatial candidates rather than relaxing length bounds
All currently supported voltages may be used for the new structure studies; voltage-level rules still apply. Village/empirical/conditioned placement retains its original voltage restrictions
Normally open ties are exported and verified open; no certification of N-1 security, protection settings, switching strategies, or automatic supply restoration
Local revisions and redesign between new structures are supported; joint topology redesign of parent cases with conditioned zero-load placement is not yet supported

Initial structured_radial generation may combine MV reference_conditioned placement to retain zero-load junctions; a reference ID and default load_shape are required. Redesign of parent cases with conditioned placement is still rejected
unsupported: Detailed low-voltage neutrals, transformers, and trunks with missing phases
Automatic reconfiguration with part of a subnet locked
Time-series switching dispatch and restoration strategies
